title: Male and Female Created by God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
searchTerms: Male and Female Created by God
definition: Male and female created by God means that God made humanity as male and female with equal dignity, real distinction, and purposeful design. This truth belongs to creation and must be received with humility before the Creator.
summary: Male and female created by God means that God made humanity as male and female with equal dignity, real distinction, and purposeful design. This truth belongs to creation and must be received with humility before the Creator.
christFocus: Jesus Christ honored God’s creation design and came to redeem both men and women into one people of grace. In Christ, male and female believers share equal access, dignity, inheritance, and calling before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that God created humanity as male and female. This distinction is not a human invention or cultural accident, but part of God’s good created order. Both man and woman bear the image of God and possess full human dignity.

Male and female are equal in worth before God while not being interchangeable in every created relation. Scripture presents distinction without inferiority and unity without erasing God’s design. This truth must be handled with reverence, humility, and compassion.

Jesus appealed to creation when teaching about marriage, showing that God’s design remains meaningful. The created distinction of male and female is therefore not disconnected from discipleship, family, embodiment, and obedience.

Sin distorts relationships between men and women through pride, domination, lust, confusion, fear, abuse, and contempt. Christ restores people into holy love, mutual honor, purity, and faithful service before God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Human identity becomes unstable when creation is rejected or despised. This doctrine reminds believers that the body is not meaningless and that God’s design is not cruel, careless, or accidental.

It also guards against both abuse and confusion. Equal dignity must never be denied, and God-given distinction must not be mocked. The church must speak this truth with conviction, tenderness, and faithfulness to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor God’s design for human embodiment, dignity, and relationships. Treat men and women as image bearers, reject lust, domination, contempt, and confusion, and submit your view of identity to Scripture. Speak truth with humility and compassion, remembering that Christ calls all people to redemption, holiness, and belonging in Him.
